from tslearn.clustering.utils import TimeSeriesCentroidBasedClusteringMixin
from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator, ClusterMixin
import numpy as np

class CustomCentroidClustering(TimeSeriesCentroidBasedClusteringMixin, ClusterMixin, BaseEstimator):
    def __init__(self):
        self.cluster_centers_ = None
        
    def fit(self, X, y=None):
        # Dummy clustering logic to satisfy the 3D array format requirement
        self.cluster_centers_ = np.zeros((2, X.shape[1], X.shape[2]))
        return self
        
    def predict(self, X):
        return np.zeros(X.shape[0], dtype=int)

# Instantiate the custom child class
estimator = CustomCentroidClustering()

# Fit and predict using the pre-loaded 3D dataset X (8, 40, 1)
estimator.fit(X)
preds = estimator.predict(X)

# Verify the inheritance property and the expected behavior of the custom estimator
is_mixin = isinstance(estimator, TimeSeriesCentroidBasedClusteringMixin)
assert is_mixin is True, "Estimator must inherit from TimeSeriesCentroidBasedClusteringMixin"
assert estimator.cluster_centers_.shape == (2, 40, 1), f"Expected cluster centers shape (2, 40, 1), got {estimator.cluster_centers_.shape}"
assert preds.shape == (8,), f"Expected predictions shape (8,), got {preds.shape}"

print(f"__CHECK__ TimeSeriesCentroidBasedClusteringMixin {is_mixin}")
